limitations: Exact source constructors/object_info, TemplatePrefix finalization, acquisition, V3 mapper/clone/lock, nested input reconstruction and CreateList; not PromptExecutor validation or frontend.
Exact JSON values and explicit ordered key lists, no numeric tolerance. Unsupported input/template cases retain source results and are not port-success expectations.
Only cache values decode a sole $blocker key into the real source ExecutionBlocker. Prompt JSON values remain ordinary data.
Fixture cache/server adapters replace infrastructure only; no PromptExecutor or required-input graph validation ran.
Unreached type families and DynamicCombo/DynamicSlot behavior are not qualified.
Profiling observations must be neutral against both fresh off executions.
